recognize_zh: 這是血球計數儀的輸出圖：左下 RBC 體積分布直方圖出現兩個峰，一個約 60 fL（小球性族群）、另一個約 95 fL（正球性族群），代表雙相紅血球（dimorphic）；白血球 DIFF/BASO 散佈圖與血小板分布則無明顯異常。
features: Bimodal RBC volume histogram with peaks at ~60 fL and ~95 fL
Microcytic peak is taller than the normocytic peak
WBC DIFF scattergram shows distinct lymphocyte, monocyte, neutrophil and eosinophil clusters
BASO channel shows only a small basophil cluster
Platelet histogram right-skewed with tail toward larger volumes, without a clear giant platelet or RBC-fragment interference peak
describe_en: Automated hematology analyzer printout shows a bimodal red cell distribution histogram with a dominant microcytic population peaking at approximately 60 fL and a second normocytic population peaking at approximately 95 fL. The leukocyte differential scattergram and basophil channel show well-separated clusters without abnormal populations. The platelet histogram is right-skewed without an obvious interference peak. The dual red cell populations explain the widened RDW, and in a patient receiving iron therapy the findings are consistent with a dimorphic red cell population from treated iron deficiency.

ddx.vs: Transfused normocytic donor cells give a similar bimodal histogram and are distinguished by transfusion history.
Agglutinates create a spurious large-volume peak with falsely low RBC count and high MCHC that corrects on warming.
Sideroblastic anemia also shows two populations but is confirmed by ring sideroblasts on marrow iron stain.
